name: Radium Development Berhad
summary: Radium Development Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the property development business in Malaysia. The company provides project management consultancy, and information technology related services, as well as operates in hotel business. The company was formerly known as Radium Development Sdn Bhd and changed its name to Radium Development Berhad in September 2021. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
